near_duplicate_threshold_rule: Fixed at cosine similarity >= 0.87 on normalized-problem character 3-5-gram TF-IDF; connected components are formed by transitive union-find.
oversized_leakage_group_policy: Any leakage group above 5% of all records is assigned wholly to TRAIN before allocation; remaining groups are deterministically balanced and exact-size repair moves whole groups only.
split_method: fixed 0.87 whole leakage groups; groups above 5% forced to TRAIN; remaining groups deterministically family-balanced; whole-group exact-size repair
mode_selection_rule: At tau=0 with cluster expansion: max macro action-family recall, then MRR, then Hit@1.
tau_selection_rule: Eligible when Hit@1 and Hit@3 are each no more than 0.01 below tau=0 for the selected mode; among eligible values maximize macro recall, then MRR, then Hit@1, then prefer smaller tau.
dev_hit_selection_tolerance_note: Deterministic DEV selection constraint; not a formal inferential non-inferiority test.
test_policy: Select mode and tau on DEV only; open Selective TEST exactly once; no post-TEST tuning.
query_features: problem_normalized and problem-only Selective SpERT structure
action_evidence_policy: After problem-only retrieval, reopen all TRAIN members of retrieved evidence clusters; each cluster contributes at most one vote per action family and per action pattern.
action_pattern: action family + canonical component anchor + canonical fault anchor
outcome_policy: positive and unknown support corroboration; negative and mixed remain visible but never count as positive support.
visibility_policy: Single-cluster support is always shown as Limited historical evidence; weak queries show Exploratory or Nearest cases only.
